target_release: development candidate from the source checkout; not a published release
dependencies: anyio and MCP dependencies installed by sf-m3

assertions: HTTP endpoint receives the X-Demo-Key and bearer credential references
HTTP tool result content and structured result are returned
neither dummy HTTP credential is present in the trace representation
stdio child receives the configured source-to-target reference and returns the expected result

compatibility.status: verified locally on macOS arm64 with Python 3.14.7; no external endpoint

assertions: ACP manifest references the parent key by name and does not place its value in the manifest
local ACP fixture confirms the key is present without emitting it and trace view omits its value
local ACP fixture verifies the child HOME differs from the explicitly referenced parent HOME
captured MCP tool result contains the shipping server's actual text and structured result

compatibility.mode: local process and stdio MCP; no provider request
compatibility.status: verified locally; fixture is not a general ACP conformance test

network: No external network. HTTP endpoint binds to loopback; stdio server is a local Python subprocess.
credentials: Fixed dummy values are created inside the pytest process and are not real provider credentials.
cleanup: AsyncMCPTestKit closes direct transports and stdio children; pytest restores modified environment variables; the loopback server is closed after the test.
